A '''fangvine''' was a type of [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]]; when [[Abeloth]] flattened a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] with a blast, she unleashed fangvines that hunted fleeing woodland animals.
